android.observedDefect: At180% Arabic text in the native HTTPS fixture, success notice, simulated-service banner and three rows of navigation occupied the entire visible phone. The final recorded phase is profile-save-scroll:before and no profile content is visible in the failure screen.
android.repair: Use horizontally scrollable Material tabs on narrow phones at large text. Bound the combined message area to35% of the remaining viewport while retaining scrolling and all notice text. Preserve a weighted content region.
checks: No font-scale reduction, hidden notice text, removed tabs or identity/storage mutation introduced.
Only the navigation-row scroll state is keyed to display geometry/language; selected destination and application state remain outside that key.
Tab reveal helper requires the real semantics node, supported horizontal scrolling when applicable, and actual visibility before each original touch click.
All existing test methods and behavior assertions in changed Android test files remain, after normalizing added revealNavigationTab calls.
Native HTTPS test now asserts a displayed profile viewport of at least120dp and captures it before the original Save scrolling and click.
CI class selection, skipped tests, network boundaries, identity checks and timeouts are unchanged.
android.publisherProvenanceQualification: Author/root identify selective reuse from842472684b194e993355f632902ccc81366c164c. That object is absent from this reviewer isolated clone, so the reviewer independently assessed the resulting patch, not the remote publisher commit contents.

iphone.observedDefect: The run32 captured URL field remains focused with a middle caret and its original value; no edit menu is visible after the attempted long press. The Select All assertion fails before deletion.
iphone.repair: Preserve the successful Select All route. If that action is unavailable, only a nonsecure text/search field whose previous value contains no newline may use the documented3tap/1touch paragraph-selection gesture. Delete once, require exact empty value, then type and require exact final value.

checks.menuAssertionChange: The interaction-specific assertion now accepts a reachable Select All action or an eligible single-line native field; it does not infer successful selection. The mandatory exact-empty assertion verifies the actual outcome before replacement.

iphone.inferenceQualification: Apple documents paragraph selection via triple tap and XCTest supports multiple taps. Applying that gesture to a single-line URL is a bounded implementation inference; it is not corrected-device runtime evidence.

remainingAcceptance: Rerun all required gates on the exact integrated source, retaining actual counts and source/tree provenance.
